keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «고개를 들어 보니 반 친구들이 사라졌다(문제)» 와 «파란 제복을 입은 직원에게 도움을 요청했다(해결)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (Hana's class was gone) and the solution (she asked a woman in a blue uniform for help). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Hana, her teacher, a museum staff member
Hana got lost from her class in the museum.
She stayed calm and asked a staff member for help.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

sum.pre: Hana looked at an old golden

and ask a staff member. A woman in a blue

words: a building where old or special things are shown
a gold ring that a king or queen wears on the head
stay calm and ask a staff member
Hana took a deep breath and looked around.
the air you take into your body
a small machine for talking to people far away

qs.q: Why did Hana get lost from her class?
qs.qko: 하나는 왜 반 친구들과 떨어지게 되었나요?
opts: She stopped to look at a crown for a long time.
Her teacher told her to wait alone.
evs: Hana took a deep breath and looked around.
She stopped to look at an old golden crown for a long time.
A few minutes later, her teacher came and gave her a big hug.
On a school trip, Hana visited a big history museum.
why: 하나는 금관을 보려고 멈춰 서서 한참 동안 바라보았어요. 그사이 반 친구들이 가 버렸어요. 선생님이 혼자 기다리라고 했다거나 하나가 도망쳤다는 말은 없어요.
Hana stopped to look at the crown for a long time, and her class moved on. Nothing says her teacher told her to wait or that she ran away.

qs.q: The teacher said, "ask a staff member." In this story, who is a staff member?
qs.qko: 선생님이 "ask a staff member."라고 했어요. 이 이야기에서 "staff member"는 누구인가요?
opts: a person who works at the museum
a visitor looking at the crown
evs: When she looked up, her class was gone.
She saw a woman in a blue uniform and said, "Excuse me, I lost my class."
A few minutes later, her teacher came and gave her a big hug.
She stopped to look at an old golden crown for a long time.
why: 하나가 도움을 청한 사람은 파란 제복을 입은 여자였어요. 제복은 박물관에서 일하는 사람이 입는 옷이에요.
Hana asked a woman in a blue uniform. Workers at the museum wear uniforms.

qs.q: How did Hana find her class again?
qs.qko: 하나는 어떻게 반 친구들을 다시 찾았나요?
opts: She asked a staff member, who called her teacher.
She looked at a map and walked back.
She waited at the door until school ended.
evs: The woman smiled and called the teacher on her radio.
Her heart beat fast, and she wanted to cry.
She saw a woman in a blue uniform and said, "Excuse me, I lost my class."
She stopped to look at an old golden crown for a long time.
why: 하나는 파란 제복을 입은 직원에게 반을 잃어버렸다고 말했고, 직원은 무전기로 선생님을 불렀어요. 두 문장을 이으면 답이 나와요.
Hana told the woman in a blue uniform that she lost her class, and the woman called the teacher on her radio. Put these two clues together.

ends: On the next trip, Hana helps a lost little boy.
다음 체험학습에서 하나가 길 잃은 남자아이를 도와줘요.
Hana's class visits a big science museum.

write.src: “We should <u>stay together on a trip</u> so that <u>nobody gets lost</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «해야 할 일 + 그 목적» 으로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what we should do and its purpose in English.

chips.a: hold hands when we cross the road
chips.label: road

chips.a: bring water on a hot day
chips.label: water

write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «so that» 뒤에는 «누가 + 무엇을 한다» 를 쓰세요. (예: so that we stay safe)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «so that», write who + what happens. (e.g. so that we stay safe)
